notes: Beta: fixes what's playing going stale on your station's page after 1.17.34. The secure address was being sent on every update, and a database that hasn't been given the newer rules rejects the whole update rather than just that part — so nothing got through. It's only sent when there's actually a secure address to send, and the app says so if the rules are holding it back. The station's own page also stays linked as a fallback when the stream plays here.
